models.collectorNote: First-generation LS 400s are the connoisseur buy: the over-engineering is real, parts support is Toyota-deep, and clean low-mile cars are quietly disappearing into collections.

generations.name: LS 400
generations.note: Five years, 450 prototypes, and a billion dollars bought a 4.0-litre V8 so smooth Lexus balanced a pyramid of champagne glasses on the bonnet in the ads.

generations.name: LS 460 / LS 600h
generations.note: The first eight-speed automatic in the class, and a hybrid flagship, the 600h paired a 5.0 V8 with electric motors when hybrids were still economy-car tech.

generations.name: LS 500
generations.note: No V8 for the first time, a twin-turbo V6 on the GA-L platform shared with the LC coupé. The styling finally matched the engineering ambition.

models.intro: The car that launched a marque. Toyota's secret Flagship One project produced a V8 saloon quieter and cheaper than a Mercedes S-Class, and German boardrooms have respected Lexus ever since.
models.name: LS
models.photoCredit: Photo: Dinkun Chen, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons

photos.caption: LEXUS LS (XF40) China
photos.credit: Photo: Dinkun Chen, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons

models.collectorNote: All 500 are accounted for and values never dipped the way speculators feared. The V10's soundtrack is the appreciating asset; buy the service history with the car.

generations.name: LFA
generations.note: The engine is the car: a 4.8-litre V10 with titanium internals and a soundtrack tuned like an instrument. The Nürburgring Package lapped the 'Ring in 7:14 in 2011.

models.intro: A decade in development, a carbon tub, and a Yamaha-co-developed V10 that revs to 9,000 rpm faster than an analogue tach could follow, so the dial went digital. 500 built, each at a loss.
models.name: LFA
models.photoCredit: Photo: 先従隗始, CC0, via Wikimedia Commons

photos.caption: LFA production coupe, side profile
photos.credit: Photo: 先従隗始, CC0, via Wikimedia Commons

generations.name: IS 200 / IS 300
generations.note: The Altezza's tail lights started a thousand imitations. The 3.0 straight six and a manual gearbox made it the driver's Lexus nobody expected.

generations.name: IS 300 / IS 350 / IS 500
generations.note: Sharper chassis, spindle grille, and in 2022 the IS 500 F Sport Performance: the 5.0 V8 from the RC F in the smallest Lexus sedan. A future classic hiding in plain sight.

models.intro: Lexus's answer to the 3 Series, sold in Japan as the Toyota Altezza, chronograph-style instruments, a jewel of a straight six, and later the V8 IS 500 as a parting gift to the segment.
models.name: IS
models.photoCredit: Photo: Kevauto, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons

photos.caption: 2021 Lexus IS 300 AWD, front 3.26.21
photos.credit: Photo: Kevauto, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons

generations.name: RX 300
generations.note: A Camry-platform wagon in a tall hat, pitched exactly at American buyers leaving sedans. It created the segment every premium brand now depends on.

generations.name: RX 350 / RX 450h
generations.note: The fourth generation added a seven-seat L variant and the sharpest interpretation of the spindle grille. Hybrid remained the volume powertrain.

generations.name: RX 350 / RX 500h
generations.note: Fifth generation went four-cylinder only, turbo, hybrid, and a plug-in, on the TNGA-K platform, with the 500h F Sport Performance as the quick one.

models.intro: The original luxury crossover, a car-based SUV before the industry had a name for it. The RX hybrid of 2005 also made electrification a luxury feature rather than a compromise.
models.name: RX
models.photoCredit: Photo: Szeremeta, CC BY 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons

photos.caption: 2026 Lexus RX 450h+ Luxury (3)
photos.credit: Photo: Szeremeta, CC BY 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons

models.collectorNote: One of the last naturally aspirated GTs. The limited Inspiration Series cars, and any V8 in Structural Blue, are the ones to chase.

generations.name: LC 500 / LC 500h
generations.note: The 5.0-litre V8 is the one to have, the hybrid V6 is cleverer and slower-feeling. A convertible joined in 2021. Production winds down mid-decade, unreplaced.

models.intro: The LF-LC concept car made production almost unchanged, a V8 grand tourer with concept-car surfacing, a ten-speed automatic, and one of the great interiors of its decade.
models.name: LC
